page_title: LEC 1-0 EMP | Lecce v Empoli 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Maurizio Mariani has ended the second half.
90+3' It will be a corner kick for Empoli.
90+1' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Lecce players have a reason to celebrate!
90+1' Wait! Referee Maurizio Mariani has indicated he is going to review the Lecce goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Santiago Pierotti tees up Nicola Sansone (Lecce) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Elia Caprile.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Remi Oudin departs the field of play to be replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
88' Here is a change. Valentin Gendrey is going off and Luca Gotti gives the last tactical orders to Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce).
86' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
84' Substitution. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) replaces Giuseppe Pezzella.
82' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
81' The corner from Remi Oudin (Lecce) is intercepted by Elia Caprile.
77' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) makes a slide tackle, but referee Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
73' Luca Gotti decides to make a substitution. Patrick Dorgu will be replaced by Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
71' Empoli are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
70' Simone Bastoni goes off the pitch and Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) comes on.
69' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
67' Razvan Marin (Empoli) and Sebastiano Luperto matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
65' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
64' Remi Oudin (Lecce) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
64' Remi Oudin (Lecce) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
63' The resulting corner from Razvan Marin (Empoli) comes to nothing.
62' The substitution is prepared. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pontus Almqvist.
60' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with M'Baye Niang (Empoli) replacing Alberto Cerri.
60' Substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) on for Matteo Cancellieri.
60' That's the end of the game for Szymon Zurkowski, who is replaced by Youssef Maleh (Empoli).
59' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Valentin Gendrey (Lecce), but it's just wide of the left post.
59' The ball is out of play and Lecce manage to earn a corner.
58' Remi Oudin (Lecce) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

58' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
57' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lecce.
54' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lecce.
52' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Maurizio Mariani signals.
50' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
49' Alexis Blin (Lecce) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
46' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' That's all for today as the game is over.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) blows an opportunity from close range as he heads a rebound onto to the crossbar!
45' Remi Oudin (Lecce) will deliver the corner kick.
44' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
41' PENALTY APPEAL by Lecce, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

38' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) wins himself just enough space to meet the corner and shoots. The shot goes towards the bottom right corner, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a decent save and thwarts the effort.
37' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
36' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Empoli out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
33' The corner by Remi Oudin (Lecce) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
32' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Elia Caprile.
30' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:0.
27' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
24' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) smashes the ball upfield and Roberto Piccoli brings it down with a fine first touch.
21' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
20' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner.

20' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the right side of the goal, but Elia Caprile makes a magnificent save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
19' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) takes a direct free kick.
15' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) brings his opponent down. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
13' The Empoli players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
10' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for handball!
7' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Empoli players aren’t happy.
5' Spectacular goal! Alberto Cerri (Empoli) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
5' Surely that's handball by one of the Empoli players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Maurizio Mariani sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
The players are on the pitch and Lecce will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Maurizio Mariani.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
